name: payment-failed-banner
title: Payment failed banner
description: A banner for a failed subscription payment: which card, the date it becomes a problem, and one button to fix it. Turns destructive once access is paused.
docs: cardLabel is what follows "your" ("card ending 4242"), graceEndsAt is the end of the grace period and status is 'grace' (the default) or 'overdue', which turns the banner destructive and says that access is paused. onUpdate runs when Update payment method is pressed and may return a promise: the button shows a spinner until it settles and then takes the focus back, which a disabled button loses. invoiceHref adds a quiet View invoice link. The date is a time element written in timeZone and locale, with the full day, time and zone in its title. There is no close button on purpose: render the banner only while the payment is unresolved. The banner is a labelled region, not a live one. labels carries every word.
